outcome: Accuracy of EFW for predicting birth weight (BWT)
Predicted survival based on EFW and BWT using the NICHD algorithm
cohort: 93 infants born between 22(0/7) and 25(6/7) weeks gestation
finding: The accuracy of EFW for predicting birth weight near viability was similar to previous studies, and estimated newborn survival based on EFW was similar to that based on BWT.
